description: The MH-13 Regional Transport Office serves the Solapur region in Maharashtra, managing vehicle registrations and licensing for one of the state's major textile and industrial hubs. It operates as a Deputy RTO under the Pune transport division, ensuring road safety and transport regulation compliance across the city and surrounding talukas.
address: Deputy Regional Transport Office, Vijapur Road, S.T. Colony, Shivaji Nagar, Solapur
